name: Agent OS Control Room
tagline: A dashboard for watching agent swarms work.
summary: An orchestration dashboard for agent swarms running in the workspace — what is running, what it is doing, and what it produced.

built: The orchestration dashboard over agent swarm state
notBuilt: The agent runtime and coordination layer it observes

caseStudy.problem: Running several agents at once is hard to supervise from a terminal. Without a view of what is in flight, the failure mode is discovering an hour later that three agents did the same thing.
caseStudy.approach: A dashboard over swarm state — what is running, what each agent is doing, and what came out of it.

visuals.alt: Illustration of an orchestration dashboard listing running agents
visuals.caption: Illustration of the control room. Not a screenshot — no capture of the running app has been published yet.

limitations: Never progressed past a prototype; the source was removed from the ecosystem during the 2026-08 migration and this write-up survives as provenance.

sourceRemoved.note: Source no longer exists in the monorepo (removed from apps/registry.json on main). Kept as a historical case study.
